title: Liberty Agent Settlement receipt
description: JSON Schema for a client-held terminal Settlement receipt (status released or disputed). Same expanded object as receipt export JSON, POST /api/v0/verify `receipt`, and the payload decoded from a shareable `#receipt/r1.…` or `?receipt=` link (compact short keys expand to these fields). Client-held demo; Liberty does not persist receipts, take custody, or move real money. A receipt is not proof of payment.

JobId.description: Job id assigned at create. as_ plus 10 hex characters.

KeyId.description: Present when a demo key header was sent. SHA-256 hex prefix. Never the raw key.

Amount.description: Job amount in integer demo credits. Not real money.

Credits.description: Integer demo credits. Not real money. Not proof of payment.

Criteria.description: Success criteria. Same text as the job.

Proof.description: Proof URL or text. May be empty until submit; terminal receipts usually have a string.

Created.description: Created stamp from the job. Live receipts use ISO-8601 UTC.

Stamp.description: Funded, submitted, or resolved stamp. Null if that step has no time. Live receipts use ISO-8601 UTC or null.

ClientRef.description: Adapter/correlation id stamped on create. Empty or whitespace-only is rejected.

CallbackUrl.description: Adapter-owned https URL stamped on create (notify_url alias). Liberty never HTTP-fetches or calls it.

Note.description: Optional note. Whitespace-only is ignored. Max 400 after trim. proof_note from submit; release_note only on released; dispute_reason only on disputed.

Status.description: Terminal only. Verify and receipt export reject open, funded, and submitted.

Receipt.description: Expanded receipt. Canonical snake_case matches export, verify examples, and receiptFromJob. camelCase and a few aliases are accepted by verify and receipt-export. Compact short keys (j, t, s, …) are encoding-only inside an r1. token — expand them before POST /api/v0/verify.

CompactReceipt.description: Packed receipt inside an r1. token ({ v: 1, receipt }). Short keys only. Clients expand these to the Receipt fields before verify. Not a second public API.

ReceiptLinkPayload.description: JSON inside an r1. base64url token before expand. Hash form is #receipt/<token>. Query form is ?receipt=<token>. Credits, jobs, and the demo API key are not in this payload. Not proof of payment.

v.description: Receipt-link version. Only v=1 is accepted.
